mapper.insert: INSERT INTO item (fridge_id, category_id, name, expiration_date, memo, created_at, barcode) VALUES (#{fridgeId}, #{categoryId}, #{name}, #{expirationDate}, #{memo}, #{createdAt}, #{barcode})
mapper.update: UPDATE item SET fridge_id = #{fridgeId}, category_id = #{categoryId}, name = #{name}, expiration_date = #{expirationDate}, memo = #{memo}, created_at = #{createdAt}, barcode = #{barcode} WHERE item_id = #{itemId}
UPDATE item SET barcode = #{barcode} WHERE item_id = #{itemId}
